title: How a crypto launchpad platform can run token sales and investor management on cryptool
content_html:
Your community wants to sell a new token but you cannot see who owns what, how many tokens each investor should get, or when those tokens should unlock. You cannot send updates to each investor without spending hours on spreadsheets. The result is missed deadlines, angry investors, and lost credibility.

A crypto launchpad platform can solve these problems by giving you a single place to create sale pools, track member allocations, set vesting schedules, and automate distributions. Below is a step‑by‑step guide on how to use cryptool to run a token sale from start to finish. The guide works for any EVM chain and for MultiversX, and it works with any wallet you already use.

Create a sale pool and invite participants

1. Open the launchpad module.
2. Choose the token contract you want to sell.
3. Set the total amount of tokens you will offer.
4. Add the list of investor wallet addresses.
5. Define the price per token and the start and end dates.

When the pool is live, each investor can see the pool details in their own wallet dashboard. The platform records every commitment on chain, so you have an immutable audit trail.

Manage allocations and vesting schedules

After the sale ends, the platform calculates how many tokens each address receives. You can:

  • Assign a flat allocation based on the amount each investor paid.
  • Add a custom vesting schedule for each investor or for groups of investors.
  • Set cliff periods and linear release rates.

All of this data lives on chain, so you do not need to maintain separate spreadsheets. The platform also lets you edit a schedule before the first release if you need to make a change.

Automate token distributions and investor communications

When a vesting milestone arrives, the platform sends the tokens directly to the investor wallets. No manual transaction is required. At the same time, the platform sends an email or in‑app notification that tells the investor the amount that was released. This keeps your community informed and reduces support tickets.

You can also batch a distribution if many investors have the same schedule. The batch runs in a single transaction.

Track performance and generate reports

The launchpad module provides a real‑time view of:

  • Total tokens sold.
  • Funds raised in native currency.
  • Tokens released versus tokens still locked.
  • Investor participation by wallet.

You can export a CSV file for accounting or share a read‑only link with your team. The data is pulled directly from the blockchain, so you can trust the numbers.

Why use this approach

  • All wallets stay in your control. The platform never holds any funds.
  • The workflow works on any EVM chain and on MultiversX, so you do not need separate tools for each network.
  • The same interface supports both small community sales and larger launchpad events.
  • Over 15,000 users already rely on the same tools to run their token sales.

Running a token sale should not require a dozen different apps or a team of developers. A crypto launchpad platform gives you the structure you need while letting you keep full control of your assets.

If you want a single dashboard that can create pools, manage allocations, set vesting, automate distributions, and keep investors in the loop, you might want to check out cryptool.
